fills.researcher_notes: This row is the DP3-DP4 leg of the Bouri Gas Utilisation Project (BGUP). NS Energy Business's BGUP project profile: 'Operator/Developer: Mellitah Oil & Gas (consortium of National Oil Corporation of Libya and Eni North Africa)'. Independently, Eni's June 2026 press release (primary source, distinct origin) lists the 'Bouri Gas Utilization Project' as operated through the Mellitah Oil & Gas joint venture, 'currently undergoing tie-in and commissioning'. High tier: two independent origins agree.

validity.recommendation: Confirmed: keep this row's LengthKnownKm at 8.5 km (Diameter 14) as-is. Do NOT change it to match the drawn 65.8 km whole-line route -- the length_ratio flag is a segment-vs-network granularity artifact, exactly as the brief warned.
validity.researcher_notes: NS Energy's BGUP project profile independently breaks the line into the same two segments GEM tracks separately: 'DP3 to DP4 Connection -- Length: 8.5 km, Diameter: 14-inch, cladded pipe, transport raw gas from DP3 to DP4' and 'DP4 to Sabratah Platform -- Length: ~20 km, Diameters: 10-inch and 4-inch carbon steel'. The 8.5 km / 14in figure for this row (P6716, SegmentName='DP3-DP4') matches NS Energy exactly. The drawn route geometry (65.8 km, DP3 to the Sabratha platform) covers the full DP3-DP4-Sabratha corridor, i.e. both segments combined plus the platform-to-platform routing distance, which is why it doesn't match this row's segment-only length. Companion segment P7617 ('DP4-Sabratha', sheet LengthKnownKm=20, Diameter='10,4') matches the NS Energy breakdown for the second leg as well.
